name: How much does it cost to move appliances in a kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to move appliances as part of a kitchen layout change?
mainEntity.text: How much does it cost to move appliances as part of a kitchen layout change?

acceptedAnswer.text: Moving appliances is often one of the biggest cost drivers in a kitchen layout change. A refrigerator may be relatively straightforward, while a sink, dishwasher, cooktop, or wall oven can require significant mechanical work. If the new location needs updated plumbing, gas, electrical circuits, or ventilation, the cost rises further. The final price depends on how far each appliance moves and whether the change affects cabinets, countertops, or walls. Homeowners should also think about whether a move improves the kitchen enough to justify the expense. Sometimes the best design keeps the appliance in place and improves the surrounding workflow instead. A clear estimate should separate the appliance move itself from the supporting work behind it, since the hidden infrastructure can be the real cost. This is one area where design decisions and construction costs are tightly linked.
